hero.sub: Architecting autonomous AI agents and data pipelines. Specialized in <1>LLM orchestration</1> and real-time infrastructure. Turning research into production-grade impact.

research_agent.title: Autonomous Research Agent
research_agent.desc: Multi-modal agent capable of complex reasoning, web-browsing, and report synthesis using ReAct pattern.

data_quality.title: Data Quality Agent Mesh
data_quality.desc: LangGraph multi-agent system that profiles datasets, detects anomalies, and auto-opens GitHub issues.

bi_copilot.title: Agentic BI Co-Pilot
bi_copilot.desc: Chat interface where users ask questions; agent selects data marts, generates SQL, and returns charts.

self_healing.title: Self-Healing Data Pipeline
self_healing.desc: Agent monitors Airflow health, proposes fixes, and rolls back bad deployments via GitOps.

fraud_stream.title: Real-Time Fraud Stream
fraud_stream.desc: Kafka/Spark pipeline processing 10k+ events/sec with sub-50ms latency and automated alerting.

customer_360.title: Streaming Customer 360
customer_360.desc: Real-time ingestion of clickstream and CRM data into a unified dimensional warehouse.

mlops.title: MLOps Lifecycle Pipeline
mlops.desc: End-to-end flow: raw data → feature store → training → deployment → drift monitoring.

kpi_storyteller.title: Agentic KPI Storyteller
kpi_storyteller.desc: Pulls network metrics, computes KPIs, and generates weekly operational summaries using an LLM.

churn_simulator.title: Revenue & Churn Simulator
churn_simulator.desc: Interactive Monte Carlo simulator where users adjust inputs and an agent explains outcomes.

devops_assistant.title: DevOps Deployment Assistant
devops_assistant.desc: Agent reads repo, writes optimized Dockerfiles, generates K8s manifests, and opens PRs.

obs_as_code.title: Observability-as-Code
obs_as_code.desc: Platform to define monitoring alerts and Grafana dashboards as infrastructure code via CLI and UI.

data_product.title: Data Product Platform Template
data_product.desc: Production-grade Cookiecutter template including ingestion, warehouse, dbt models, and CI/CD.

knowledge_base.title: Enterprise Knowledge Base
knowledge_base.desc: Vector search infrastructure (Pinecone) serving 50M+ documents with high-accuracy retrieval.
